# MoneroPHP source correspondence

`base58.php` and `Cryptonote.php` match monero-integrations/monerophp commit
`101e73dae3f36ff8bb6dbb09c80a912b67f508a6`, with the existing WordPress
`ABSPATH` direct-access guards retained. The same upstream repair is used by
the standalone XMRPay PHP engine. Existing copyright and MIT license notices
remain in the source files.

This pin identifies these two files only; it does not identify the revisions
of the other bundled primitives or transfer an upstream audit to this plugin.
